[[Private/Legends|Private]] '''Leen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was stationed aboard [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Empire, where he sold [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]], [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]], and a vaccine for the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Personality and traits==
Leen had [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and fair skin. He wore the grey [[Hat/Legends|cap]] and [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] commonly worn by Imperial personnel, with a [[Belt/Legends|belt]] and [[Glove/Legends|gloves]]. On his tunic was a [[rank insignia plaque]] that had eight squares; four blue, two red, and two yellow.<ref name="TOR" />
